submittedParameters.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Edit image1 only. It is the already-designed character animation frame. Images2/3/4 provide identity/direction/style evidence only; do not reinterpret or recompose from them. Follow the precise correction below and preserve everything else. Output one full 1254x1254 RGBA transparent independent sprite. CORRECT LOWER-BODY GROUNDING PHASE ONLY. Preserve face, FIVE talisman cards right hand, bell left hand, upper body, head physical size and canvas framing EXACTLY. SOUTH frame12 late single support preceding opposite push-off. Anatomical RIGHT leg on viewer LEFT supports body; knee straightens moderately, shin goes to rear shoe forefoot firmly down under/behind hip at x480 y1100, heel slightly lifted. Its shoe heel-to-toe axis points straight DOWN toward viewer, never outward left. Anatomical LEFT leg viewer RIGHT swings forward: bent knee x720 y960, airborne forward shoe x750 y1080. Front shoe also straight toward viewer; no outward ankle twist. TWO legs with clean hip-knee-ankle connections. It must show one toe firmly supporting and the other foot airborne, not both floating. No shadow/ground/effects; retain exact global character scale and composition, do not zoom.
